authority.integrationAuthority: coordinator-only after independent combined rereview and separate CD-RT-5 disposition

reviewFindingTransfers.closure: EP6 recomputes one exact same-project C2/RI/manifest/seal authority chain before core.
Closed raw receipts and a unique ProjectId-scoped seal index construct the only opaque authority capability; post-core RunAuthorityIndex equality-rejoins that chain.
The retained closed wire grammar is regenerated over RT11's actual raw closure and EP6's corrected authority identities.
EP6/RT11 feed VERSIONING v6, then Evidence v5; the post-core authority index creates no semantic back-edge.
EP6 semantic commitments resolve to RT11 raw-only custody and the Evidence inventory is an exact projection of derived proof refs.
Candidate has no index; EP7 host store authorizes it, and Evidence v6 requires the identical store instance/handle continuity for atomic finalization.

A fresh ProjectStoreAuthority session over explicit durable project state cold-resolves EP8 authority, rederives RT13 custody and unchanged SemanticEvidence, remints live capabilities, and converges through the same six-write transaction without old tokens or process-global ledger authority.

recursiveRequestIdExclusion.rule: RequestId and ExecutionId are operational-only. Every named semantic record is exact/closed; neither identity may occur at the root or any nested semantic item. Unknown fields reject rather than being ignored.
recursiveRequestIdExclusion.differential: Two RequestIds and distinct ExecutionIds over byte-equal semantic inputs and sealed target produce identical inventory, SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId, TerminalRun and runSealRef; they differ only in AttemptRunLinkV1 and operational records.
recursiveRequestIdExclusion.negativeControl: Inject requestId or executionId at each root and each nested semantic collection item; exact decoding/admission rejects before hashing or core authority use.

dependencies.dependencyDirection: EP8 and RT13 feed VERSIONING v8; Evidence v7 binds all three and adds durable cold recovery. VERSIONING v8 has no Evidence/store-token back-edge.

importedAuthorityContract.storedReadApi: ProjectStoreAuthorityV1.resolve_stored_evaluation(EASRef) from immutable CAS plus EvaluationAuthorityIndexV1 only
importedAuthorityContract.identityExclusion: Store/transaction/capability tokens are operational-only and excluded from every semantic/content identity and serialized record.
importedAuthorityContract.onePortRule: EP8 authority operations and Evidence v7 journal/run operations are traits of one production opensip_store ProjectStoreAuthorityV1 nominal port; the checker composite is one session, not a second public store type.

scalarEncoding.text: NFC UTF-8, no BOM, non-empty, no U+0000..U+001F or U+007F; identifiers and enums retain their closed ASCII grammar
scalarEncoding.canonicalUnsignedDecimal: ASCII digits; zero is 0; otherwise no leading zero

recordRules.presence: every declared field exactly once; no optional or undeclared bytes
recordRules.sets: sort complete item record bytes unsigned; reject duplicates instead of silently deduplicating
recordRules.decoding: reject non-NFC, noncanonical decimal, tag/order/length mismatch, duplicate, omitted, unknown, trailing, or overlong bytes

RawProofInventoryV1.equalityRule: Exact projection of RT11 SemanticCapabilityClosureV3.proofRefs after requiring identityKind=raw-cas and every item ProjectId equal the outer ProjectId. Preserve recordCasRef, recordKind, and requiredForCapability exactly; zero items is permitted only when RT11 validates that capability.

TerminalRunV1.rawHashRule: runSealRef = sha256:<lowerhex SHA-256(exact TerminalRunV1 bytes)>; runSealRef is external and MUST NOT occur in TerminalRunV1.

commitments.canonicalJsonRawCas: sha256:<lowerhex SHA-256(opensip-canonical-json-v1(value))>; no domain, BOM, whitespace, or trailing newline

semanticJoins.preCoreAuthority: EP7 ProjectStoreAuthorityV1.authorize_evaluation returns the only accepted opaque capability after exact same-project C2/RI/raw validation plus trusted CAS/index publication and reread.
semanticJoins.retention: RawProofInventoryV1 equals RT12 semanticClosure.proofRefs exactly; all physical identities are RawCasRef.
semanticJoins.versioning: VERSIONING v7 historical and authority dependencies are already inside the same RT12 derived raw closure; store tokens are excluded.
semanticJoins.terminalAuthority: TerminalRunV1 ProjectId, PlanId, PlanIntent commitment, ExecutionPlan commitment, ActivationManifest ref and EvaluationAuthoritySeal ref equal the admitted receipts exactly.
semanticJoins.postCoreIndex: RunAuthorityIndexV1 equality-rejoins TerminalRunV1 to PlanAuthorityReceiptV1 and EvaluationAuthorityAdmissionV1 inside the same atomic final transaction.

projection.name: EvidenceReadProjectionV1
projection.rule: Recompute on every stored read from verified persisted bytes plus RT12 UnitAvailabilityRecordV2 and VERSIONING v7 verifier availability. Never store, CAS-address, or include this projection in EvidenceDigest/RunId/TerminalRun.

calls: opensip_evidence.project_read_v1(VerifiedStoredRunV1, RT13 mutableState, VERSIONING v8 availability) -> EvidenceReadProjectionV1
apiContract.constructionRule: There is one production ProjectStoreAuthorityV1 nominal port. Fresh recovery accepts only that live port plus ExecutionId, reads the journal itself, cold-resolves EP8 authority, and remints finalized/custody capabilities under the new session. No overload accepts caller journal/candidate/inventory, an old handle/token, raw JSON, supplied PlanId/RunId/ref, owner string or verified/pinned boolean.

CustodyPreparationMaterialV1.authorityRule: durable locator/material only; recovery freshly derives every value and requires exact equality

CustodyPreparedObjectV1.authorityRule: the trusted durable row set must equal the freshly derived RT13 unit/object set; no prepared boolean or opaque token

RunIndexV1.uniqueness: append-only; same key/same runSealRef is idempotent; same key/different ref is LEDGER.CORRUPT

AttemptRunLinkV1.uniqueness: one Run per Attempt; many Attempts may link the same content-derived Run

RunCustodyRootV1.boundary: operational reachability/lineage outside EvidenceDigest; unitIds are exact RT11 UNIT-ID-V3 values

transaction: Through one fresh ProjectStoreAuthorityV1 session over DurableProjectStateV1, cold-resolve EP8 authority and reread/rehash bundle, RT13 closure, raw inventory, SemanticEvidence, explicit target, custody preparation and Attempt revision.
Derive EvidenceDigest and an opaque candidate RunId; build TerminalRunV1; write Terminal bytes to a private staging namespace not served by public CAS lookup.
In one serializable transaction publish-or-verify the exact six final records and remove RunFreePreparedCommitV2; journal removal and custody transfer do not add a seventh published record.
Return CommittedRunV1 only after commit. A transaction failure emits no RunId and leaves no public Run index or terminal object.
recovery: Before journal: hidden/orphan CAS is garbage-collectable and no Run exists.

Journal exists but no index/link: open a fresh session over the same durable state; EP8 cold-resolves EAS; reread and rederive SemanticEvidence plus RT13 closure/raw inventory; remint finalized evidence and custody under that session; retry with the same session.
Commit succeeded but response was lost: exact Attempt link and Run index return the committed result idempotently.

Index/link and all other four peers exist exactly with no journal: success. Neither exists with a journal: retry. Exactly one, any partial/conflicting six-set, or committed peers plus a journal: LEDGER.CORRUPT; never guess or overwrite.
Concurrent semantically identical Attempts converge on one RunIndex/RunCustodyRoot and retain distinct AttemptRunLink/outbox rows.
storeContract.publicVisibility: Analysis events, logs, diagnostics, errors, responses and public CAS/index lookup forbid the candidate RunId before final commit. Stored-view may carry an already committed RunId and creates no new Run.

finalTransaction.precondition: the current-session ProjectStoreAuthorityV1 and freshly minted EP8 handle/finalized/custody capabilities pass an in-transaction durable authority/input/custody reread; Terminal and RunAuthorityIndex fully rederive without any old token authority
finalTransaction.visibility: RunId, Terminal, RunAuthorityIndex and outbox event become public together or none do
finalTransaction.retry: same keys and byte-identical values are idempotent; any RunIndex or RunAuthorityIndex collision with different bytes is corruption

admissionAndSealOrdering: Validate RequestId and resolve an explicit project retention policy plus admitted sealed-capability target before Attempt allocation. With CD-RT-5 unresolved, an absent default is REQUEST.UNSATISFIABLE and creates no Attempt.
Allocate ExecutionId/AttemptRecord and freeze PlanIntent, AdmissionDescriptor and sealed-capability target; RequestId/ExecutionId remain operational and outside semantic commitments.

Converge snapshot, derive/recompute PlanId and ExecutionPlan commitment, freeze Coverage/core inputs, derive ActivationManifest and EP8 EvaluationAuthoritySeal, then submit the closed index-free candidate to the host-admitted ProjectStoreAuthorityV1.

ProjectStoreAuthorityV1 atomically publishes/verifies CAS, inserts/verifies and rereads its ProjectId/EAS index, mints AdmittedEvaluationAuthorityV1, and pure core accepts only that store-bound handle.

Validate the EP8 bundle; derive RT13 semantic roots/bindings, typed raw proofRefs/edges, UNIT-ID-V3 units and RunId-free closure. Require sealedCapability equal the frozen target; prepare exact durable custody material through the same port without downgrade.

Encode unchanged SemanticEvidence/EvidenceDigest; persist all referenced input/custody rows before RunFreePreparedCommitV2. Live commit uses current capabilities; restart opens a fresh session, EP8 cold-resolves and remints from durable rows. Only the atomic six-record publication exposes RunId.

sealedCapabilityContract.targetTiming: Frozen at request validation and committed in the admitted PlanIntent before Attempt/core. It cannot be selected after observing verdict or current availability.
sealedCapabilityContract.finalization: Final sealedCapability equals the admitted target exactly after RT12 closure and custody preparation. Unsupported target or failed custody does not silently demote; no Run commits.
sealedCapabilityContract.readTime: RT12 alone derives effectiveCapability from mutable raw-object availability. Availability, leases and lineage may change effectiveCapability but never sealedCapability, SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId or TerminalRun.
sealedCapabilityContract.productFork: CD-RT-5 alone decides the product default. This candidate supports explicit admitted targets and rejects an absent default; it does not claim or apply product acceptance.

d9Mapping.vocabularyRule: No new D9 class, code, axis, precedence, or exit mapping is introduced.

positiveControls.assert: Accepted EP6/RT11 vector reproduces every byte/hash above.
Two RequestIds and distinct ExecutionIds over equal semantic inputs/cap produce byte-identical inventory/Evidence/RUN/Terminal and one Run index with two Attempt links.
Removing one replay-only raw object changes only RT11 effectiveCapability/read projection; every persisted byte/hash remains exact.
Changing the admitted sealed target changes SemanticEvidence and RUN-ID-V1 even if every other scalar were equal.
Each documented crash point converges to no public Run or the one exact committed Run; no partial identity is observable.

invariants.assert: EvaluationAuthoritySealV1 is exact EP8-owned pre-core authority; only a current-session store-authorized opaque handle invokes core.
SemanticEvidence binds exact Project/Plan/seal, Coverage/universe/outcomes/proofs/verdict, raw proof inventory, sealed capability and RT13 closure without lifecycle or mutable state.
Semantic commitments and raw CAS refs are nominally distinct; only EP8 SemanticObjectBindingV1 resolves between them.
RT13 closure and UNIT-ID-V3 are content-derived and RunId-free; availability/lease/lineage/effective capability remain outside EvidenceDigest.
RUN-ID-V1 is exactly the six-field domain-framed digest and is externally visible only after atomic final commit.
TerminalRunV1 has no self-reference; external runSealRef is the raw exact-byte hash.
All six final records publish together and RunFreePreparedCommitV2 is removed in the same transaction; fresh-session recovery is exact and idempotent.
VERSIONING v8 preserves exact custody and Evidence binds exact EP8/RT13/VERSIONING v8 bytes without a dependency cycle or store-token identity leak.
Sealed capability is the pre-core admitted target, never a post-verdict maximum or silent downgrade.
RequestId/ExecutionId variation and current availability cannot change semantic bytes or content Run identity.

Durable project state is separate from ephemeral sessions; recovery authority never comes from an old handle, old store token, finalized/custody token, warm candidate, boolean, or process-global ledger.
A fresh session cold-resolves EAS, rederives SemanticEvidence/RT closure/raw inventory, exactly validates durable custody rows, remints live capabilities, and uses that same session for commit.

retainedResiduals: The checker uses guarded durable-state/session test doubles and copy/validate/swap; no production store/transaction/restart/crash durability/atomicity implementation was executed or demonstrated. Evidence grade remains IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED.
All Evidence v6/Evidence v5 SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId, Terminal, runSeal and D9/scope identities are intentionally unchanged; only durable recovery authority is strengthened.
V10 remains unresolved; CD-RT-5 and G19 remain blocked.
Independent review, product qualification and coordinator integration remain absent; no seal/signoff is authorized.

runAuthorityIndexContract.derivation: After core return, closed-decode/rederive TerminalRunV1 and require every shared identity equal the admitted plan receipt and authority admission; then stage this exact row in the final transaction.
runAuthorityIndexContract.collisionRule: An existing (ProjectId,RunId) row must be byte-identical. Same key with any different authority/terminal field is corruption and publishes nothing.
runAuthorityIndexContract.cycleExclusion: RunAuthorityIndexV1 is post-content and is excluded from SemanticEvidenceV1, EvidenceDigest, RunIdentityPreimageV1, RunId, TerminalRunV1 and runSealRef. No pre-core RunId exists.

storeCapabilityContinuityContract.collisionRule: Every key is append-only/insert-or-exact-verify. Any one-sided/partial/conflicting six-record set or surviving journal beside committed peers is LEDGER.CORRUPT and changes nothing.
storeCapabilityContinuityContract.toctouRule: Finalization cold-rereads immutable authority/input/custody rows and compares freshly minted current-session capabilities immediately before the one project-ledger transaction.
storeCapabilityContinuityContract.tokenExclusion: Store instance/transaction/continuity tokens are nonserializable operational state and do not enter SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunIdentityPreimage, RunId, TerminalRunV1, RunAuthorityIndexV1, runSealRef or RT closure.

recoveryMatrixContract.failureVisibility: Every failed or merely prepared scenario has zero newly public RunId/runSealRef/Terminal/RunAuthorityIndex/outbox; LEDGER.CORRUPT and DURABILITY.COMMIT_FAILED expose ExecutionId only.
